text.material.status.smoke_inhalation.consequ: guard and ranged reach falter; reach clear air
text.material.status.wet.consequence: absorbent armour burdens the load; leave water to dry
text.material.status.chilled.consequence: aim, treatment, and recovery are slower
text.material.status.salt_grit.consequence: guard and ranged reach weaken; leave the slurry and allow four actions to clear
text.material.status.lime_grit.consequence: guard and ranged reach weaken; leave the slurry and allow four actions to clear
text.material.inspect.support.warning: Support {support}/3; COLLAPSE warned after {beats} more beats.
text.material.inspect.prediction: PREDICTION Water extinguishes; smoke rises/drifts; weakened supports fall after warning.
text.material.inspect.cover: FACT Loose cover (%) remains passable and turns low shots; height or arcing weapons can answer it.
text.material.inspect.guidance: Handling takes one action. Inspection and cancellation take none. Tools and supplies must be at hand.
text.material.item.destroyed.message: {item} is destroyed by {reaction}; its loss is recorded.
text.material.threat.fell: {threat} fell to {reaction} at {coordinate}; possessions remain physical.
text.material.armour.heat: The kiln apron takes the heat; its protective face wears. Leave the fire before it fails.
text.material.water.quench: Water quenches fire at {coordinate}; steam veils the ground.
text.material.ice.thaw: Thaw loosens the thin ice at {coordinate}.
text.material.reaction.result: {reaction} reacts at {coordinate}; shared ground and nearby bodies change.
text.material.collapse.warning: Support cracks at {coordinate}; debris will fall in two actions. Brace it or leave.
text.material.collapse.memory: A damaged support collapsed at {coordinate}; debris changed the crossing.
text.material.collapse.result: The warned support falls at {coordinate}; debris strikes the opening.
text.material.handle.invalid_target: Choose a visible material within one pace.
text.material.handle.ignite_requirement: Ignition needs dry fuel and one measure of lamp oil.
text.material.handle.tool_requirement: This work needs a cutting/levering weapon, repair tools, or Lever Craft.
text.material.handle.coffer_requirement: Stand beside a loose coffer to move it. Contents remain inside.
text.material.handle.coffer_destination: That destination cannot safely hold the coffer.
text.material.handle.water_requirement: Reach a water source first; no water is created from nothing.
text.material.handle.no_cell: This space has no accessible material or the local reaction budget is full.
text.material.handle.water_spent: The accessible measure has already been drawn.
text.material.handle.structure_requirement: There is no firm structure to work here.
text.material.handle.result: You {verb} {material} at {coordinate}; the work takes one action.
text.material.handle.heel: The iron heel bears the work, wears, and rings against the structure.
text.material.inspection.blocked.stone: A stone wall blocks that step.
text.material.inspection.remedy.stone: Use another lane; marked weak structure can be inspected with F.
text.material.inspection.remedy.timber: Follow a gap or inspect whether cutting is legal with F.
text.material.inspection.remedy.water: Find shallows, a crossing, or a disclosed water-control action.
text.material.inspection.blocked.empty: There is no traversable floor there.
text.material.inspection.remedy.empty: Use a mapped entrance or aligned vertical connection.
text.material.inspection.blocked.vessel: Fixed vessel structure blocks that step.
text.material.inspection.remedy.vessel: Use the doorway or interact with a nearby working station.
text.material.inspection.remedy.generic: Inspect with ; or take another lane.
text.material.inspection.preview.watching: wakes {actor}; they stand in your way
text.material.inspection.preview.watching_rem: attack, negotiate, or take another lane
text.material.inspection.preview.engaged_reme: attack, control, or take another lane
text.material.inspection.preview.smoke: smoke {smoke}/4 obscures sight and strains breath
text.material.inspection.preview.collapse: support is warned to collapse after {beats} more beats
text.material.inspection.preview.door: the door opens and changes sightlines
text.material.inspection.preview.fall: the step becomes a fall to the aligned level below
text.material.inspection.preview.avoid: use equipment or another lane to avoid the disclosed pressure
text.material.inspection.unknown: UNKNOWN: {x},{y} z{z} has not been observed.
text.material.inspection.unknown.detail: No actor, material reaction, or current hazard is inferred there.
text.material.inspection.remembered.detail: MEMORY: terrain only; actors and active material states are not carried by memory.
text.material.inspection.remembered.return: Return to sight before relying on fire, smoke, water, cargo, or structural state.
text.material.inspection.trace: TRACE: {clue}; approach to resolve the buried cache.
text.material.inspection.container: FACT: {container}; {state} physical store. E from beside it inspects or transfers contents.
text.material.inspection.transition: ACTION: stand here and press E to {direction} to z{z}; one action.
text.material.inspection.footer: Inspection costs no time; committing movement, E, F, A, G or M follows its displayed cost.
text.material.inspection.hint.map: [T] follow remembered ground; any key interrupts
text.material.inspection.advice.forecast: ADVICE — {speaker}: {actor}'s mark resolves after your next action; {counter}.
text.material.inspection.advice.fire: ADVICE — {speaker}: water removes fire immediately; cutting dry fuel first can stop the next spread.
text.material.inspection.advice.smoke: ADVICE — {speaker}: dense smoke breaks prepared lanes and sight; wind and clear ground determine its useful edge.
text.material.inspection.advice.collapse: ADVICE — {speaker}: a warned support falls only after its shown action; leave, brace, or interrupt before then.
text.material.inspection.advice.rain: ADVICE — {speaker}: rain checks open flame but slows exposed travel unless clothing, route, or shelter answers it.
text.material.inspection.advice.wind: ADVICE — {speaker}: the named wind shifts smoke and firing value consistently; read it before committing a lane.
text.material.inspection.advice.winter: ADVICE — {speaker}: fresh shallows can freeze; salt water thaws them, while cleats turn the firm sheet into a route.
text.material.inspection.advice.combo: ADVICE — {speaker}: your {combo} is active now; its equipment and footing are already satisfying the combination.
text.material.inspection.advice.default: ADVICE — {speaker}: inspect with ; before committing; remembered ground never reveals a present actor or reaction.
text.material.inspection.circuit: ELECTRICAL FITTING: {fitting}; {phase}{detail}. \ opens the circuit view.
